title: Topology
description: Skeletonized fixture topology (design doc §7.7): branch points + polyline segments + the per-LED association onto the skeleton. Produced by the phone-side skeletonization (Phase F) from a solved OutputMap and uploaded to a player, where it drives the O(N) pulse illuminate (Phase G). Keyed to the OutputMap it skeletonizes via mapId.

mapId.description: The OutputMap this topology was skeletonized from.

associations.description: One entry per mapped LED: which segment it lies on and where.

xyz.description: Position in meters, same frame as the OutputMap.

a.description: Branch-point id at the segment start (arclength 0); -1 for a free end.

b.description: Branch-point id at the segment end; -1 for a free end.

polyline.description: Polyline through space from a to b; arclength is measured along it starting at a.

footArclength.description: Arclength of the LED's foot point (nearest point on the segment polyline), meters from endpoint a.

dPerp.description: Perpendicular distance from the LED to its foot point, meters.
